title: NC-BCP simulation under final-transcript min-entropy leakage
summary: Extend the NC-BCP bounded-communication simulation theorem from summed per-round leakage to min-entropy loss measured against the final transcript.

formal_statement.body: For every noisy-communication bounded-collusion protocol whose leakage parameter $\ell$ bounds the worst-case conditional average min-entropy drop with respect to the final protocol transcript, prove an analogue of published Theorem 11 (Theorem 18 in IACR ePrint 2020/1246): construct a bounded-communication BCP with explicit communication overhead and statistical simulation error comparable to the source theorem. Alternatively, give a protocol showing that such a generalization is impossible.

scope.domain: Bounded-communication simulation of noisy-communication bounded-collusion protocols
assumptions: The protocol is an $(n,r,\ell,k)$ noisy-communication bounded-collusion protocol in the source model
The leakage measure is the worst-case conditional average min-entropy drop with respect to the final transcript
The target is a source-style bounded-communication simulation theorem with explicit overhead and error
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later primary text establishes the final-transcript version of the simulation theorem or gives a counterexample for the complete source-defined NC-BCP model.

provenance.note: The TIT article identifies the EUROCRYPT 2021 preliminary version; the same exact open questions are text-confirmed in IACR ePrint 2020/1246, submitted on 2020-10-09.
